name: brand-board
description: Brand identity showcase board — multi-tile modular grid presenting one cohesive identity system. The dominant pattern for branding work; plays to gpt-image-2's strength at composing dense cohesive layouts rather than isolated marks.
prefix: Create a square high-end brand identity showcase board for the following brand:
suffix: Design a polished modular grid of multiple tiles, each showing a different application of one cohesive visual identity system. CRITICAL — one tile MUST be dedicated to the canonical brand mark, isolated and vector-ready: a single tile labeled 'PRIMARY MARK / VECTOR ASSET' that contains ONLY the canonical mark — large, perfectly centered, in the brand's actual color, on a pure solid white background, with generous padding on all four sides, with crisp razor-sharp vector-clean edges, no shadows, no gradients, no halos, no texture, no overlay text, no surrounding chrome — the mark exactly as a designer would hand it to a developer to be exported as SVG. The other tiles cover the typical brand assets: logo explorations (multiple lockups of the same single iconic mark), wordmark variations, app icon at multiple sizes, editorial posters, product cards, landing page hero fragment, typography specimens, terminal output mockup or interface snippet, color palette presentation with hex codes, sticker concepts, business card mockup, t-shirt or laptop sticker mockup. Every tile should feel different in format and purpose, but all should clearly belong to the same brand world. The mark should be the same shape across every tile that shows it. Composition: square format, tightly arranged 4-column modular grid, multiple distinct tiles, dense but elegant layout, clean spacing, sharp alignment, strong typographic hierarchy. The final result should feel original, professionally composed, and extremely polished — like a real branding case study from a top studio (think COLLINS, Pentagram, Order, Bielke&Yang), not generic AI graphics. Output: square canvas, crisp at any zoom, premium presentation quality, cohesive identity system across every tile.
